brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four bases (piece 0..3,0,0) each hold a third-depth drain bin, filled with soil and planted with a seedling (prop:1 to prop:4).

requirements.requirement: A water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: One straight irrigation run (run-1) goes through all four bases at level 0. It comes in through the open west face of cell 0,0 and ends in cell 3,0.

The run passes through all four planted cells, so each cell is on the water line. The configurator only checks fit: it cannot test water flow, whether the joints seal, or whether the parts stay watertight.

finish.summary: I built a planter of four bases in a straight line, from cell (0,0) to cell (3,0). One straight irrigation pipe run (run-1) goes through all four bases: it comes in through the open west face of cell (0,0) and ends in cell (3,0). Because the pipe passes through the bases, each cell can only take a third-depth bin, so each holds a third-depth drain bin filled with soil and planted with a seedling: basil, parsley, chives and thyme. I capped every other open face and bolted the joints. The check found no rule errors, the parts don't collide, and there are no prop warnings. The parts list has 29 parts. The configurator only checks fit, so it can't tell whether the build holds water or survives outdoors. That depends on the material you print in and how you seal the pipe.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
